title: Find the average number of distinct elements found in carcinogenic molecule
question: Find the average number of distinct elements found in carcinogenic molecules that contain a sulfur atom involved in a double bond.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT T0."XCL_010", COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_003") AS element_count
  FROM molecule AS T0
  INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T0."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_002"
  WHERE T0."XCL_011" = '+'
    AND T0."XCL_010" IN (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_002"
      FROM atom AS T1b
      INNER JOIN bond AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_002" = T2b."XCL_005"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_003" = 's' AND T2b."XCL_006" = '='
    )
  GROUP BY T0."XCL_010"
) AS subquery

SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT T0."XCL_010", COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_003") AS element_count
  FROM molecule AS T0
  INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T0."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_002"
  WHERE T0."XCL_011" = '+'
    AND T0."XCL_010" IN (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_002"
      FROM atom AS T1b
      INNER JOIN bond AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_002" = T2b."XCL_005"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_003" = 's' AND T2b."XCL_006" = '='
    )
  GROUP BY T0."XCL_010"
) AS subquery

SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT T0."XCL_010", COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_003") AS element_count
  FROM molecule AS T0
  INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T0."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_002"
  WHERE T0."XCL_011" = '+'
    AND T0."XCL_010" IN (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_002"
      FROM atom AS T1b
      INNER JOIN bond AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_002" = T2b."XCL_005"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_003" = 's' AND T2b."XCL_006" = '='
    )
  GROUP BY T0."XCL_010"
) AS subquery

  FROM molecule AS T0
  INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T0."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_002"
  WHERE T0."XCL_011" = '+'
    AND T0."XCL_010" IN (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_002"
      FROM atom AS T1b

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT_COUNT)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS DISTINCT_COUNT
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN connected c1 ON a.XCL_001 = c1.XCL_007
    JOIN bond b ON c1.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
    JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
    JOIN atom a2 ON c2.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 's'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '='
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)
